item.title: Madras HC Directs CBFC to Issue Censor Certificate to Vijay Starrer 'Jana Nayagan'
item.description: Chennai: The Madras High Court on Friday directed the CBFC to grant a U/A certificate to actor-turned-politician Vijay's upcoming film 'Jana Nayagan'. On January 7, the HC had reserved its order on a petition seeking a direction to the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) to give a censor certificate under 'UA 16+' category to the much-anticipated film.
